sources.title: AI Grade Calculator - Personalized Grade Estimator
sources.snippet: The AI Grade Calculator helps teachers analyze student performance, model grading scenarios, and plan instruction more efficiently. It turns raw scores into clear insights that support grading decisions and communication.

sources.snippet: GradeCalculator.AI is an intuitive tool designed to streamline the grading process for students, educators, and parents. It provides accurate calculations of grades based on various inputs, allowing users to make informed decisions about academic performance.
